# Asset Description

This directory contains the small-scale tutorial images used in the AMD ROCm policy replication project. The charts and keyframe sequences are generated by `../code/generate_tutorial_assets.py` to verify the success rate and rollout behavior in the tutorials; the screenshots in `aup_cloud_guide/` come from the AMD / AUP cloud platform usage guide compressed package.

When generating the chart again, first prepare your experiment output directory, and then run:

```bash
python code/generate_tutorial_assets.py --source-root "$OUTPUT_ROOT"
```

`$OUTPUT_ROOT` should include batch evaluation JSONL/TSV and representative rollout videos. If `--source-root` is not provided, the script will generate charts using built-in teaching metrics and an indicator summary chart for missing videos with source explanations.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `model_status_summary.png` | Overview of the current reimplementation status for the topic |
| `smolvla_red_blue_success.png` | Comparison of the success rate of fixed instructions for SmolVLA red/clear cups |
| `act_dagger_progress_curve.png` | Change in success rate of ACT from baseline to DAgger correction |
| `smolvla_blue_failure_sequence.jpg` | Critical frames for failure of SmolVLA baseline clear cups |
| `smolvla_blue_success_sequence.jpg` | Critical frames for success of clear cups after SmolVLA weighted sampling |
| `act_failure_sequence.jpg` | Typical critical frames for failure of ACT DAgger |
| `act_success_sequence.jpg` | Critical frames for physical success of ACT DAgger |
| `pi0_raw_vs_finisher_diagnostic.png` | Diagram of diagnostic metrics at the end of pi_0 raw and script terminator |
| `pi0_ep2_raw_vs_finisher_side_by_side.mp4` | Comparison video of pi_0 episode2 raw-vs-hybrid |
| `pi0_ep2_raw_vs_finisher_frame.png` | Critical frames in the comparison video of pi_0 episode2 |
| `pi0_ep2_raw_vs_finisher_metrics.md` | Summary table of metrics for pi_0 episode2 raw-vs-hybrid |
| `metrics_snapshot.json` | Snapshot of small-volume metrics, including diagnosis for ACT, SmolVLA, pi_0 small set, pi_0 full20 open-loop, and closed-loop strict numbers |
| `collection_dataset_snapshot.json` | Summary of measurements on a AMD device for 20 episodes, 2621 frames, and 20 Hz dataset |
| `training_progress_snapshot.json` | Summary of historical training nodes for ACT, SmolVLA, pi0, and learned head |
| `training_progress_overview.png` | Overview of historical training steps and closed-loop results, to avoid misinterpreting training completion rate as success rate |
| `pi0_strict_input_results.json` | Final strict results for raw/head, fixed/random environments, and seed bug |
| `pi0_strict_input_progress.png` | Comparison diagram of fixed scenarios and random environments for pi0 strict-input |
| `pnp_four_view_strict_success.mp4` | Video of strict success measurements from four perspectives: Agent/Egocentric/Top/Side |
| `pnp_four_view_strict_success_sequence.jpg` | Sequence of critical frames at 5 moments in the four-perspective video |
| `aup_cloud_guide/` | Screenshots of the AUP Learning Cloud JupyterHub / Code Server usage guide (primary entry) |
| `amd_radeon_cloud/` | Official tutorial images for AMD Radeon Cloud Developer Cloud and screenshots of the AMD ROCm Embodied AI Policy Replication workspace (alternative entry) |
